# Support

## Usage questions

Read the following guides first:

- [Installation](../docs/INSTALLATION.md)
- [Usage](../docs/USAGE.md)
- [Hosting](../docs/HOSTING.md)
- [API reference](../docs/api.md)

If the guides do not resolve the problem, open a GitHub issue using the bug-report form. Include operating system, Python and Node.js versions, the command used, sanitized logs, and the smallest reproducible repository fixture.

## Security reports

Do not disclose a suspected vulnerability, credential, private repository content, or personal information in a public issue. Follow the [security reporting guidance](../docs/security.md).

## Project scope

SENTINEL is currently a local-first, trusted-user application. Public multi-tenant hosting and direct GitHub URL ingestion are future work, not supported production features.
